# Annual tax checklist

A sinking fund spreads a known future cost, such as a new laptop, across the months before it. Keep receipts for deductible expenses in one folder so the yearly tax filing takes an evening. Automate savings on payday so the money moves before it can be spent. Track net worth quarterly; the trend matters more than any single month. The avalanche method pays the highest interest debt first and saves the most money.

## Why it matters

Index funds win mostly on fees; a one percent fee compounds into a large loss over decades. An emergency fund of three to six months of essential costs covers most surprises. Track net worth quarterly; the trend matters more than any single month.
